title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019
verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode search hit IN_IndiaCode_201935 gives the short title 'The Consumer Protection Act, 2019', enactment 2019-08-09, handle 15256, and commencement by notification with a footnote. It replaced the Consumer Protection Act 1986.
notes: Covers consumer rights, unfair trade practices, product liability and Consumer Commissions. Tenancy is State law (see topic_gaps).
